statement_dispositions.disposition: Construction equation deduplicated; game forward-equivalence theorem retained.
statement_dispositions.reason: The repeated entropy-pair construction ptnb:eq:softplus-decomp aliases eq:fsoft_def in cor:fsoft. The game SPNE and forward-value theorem remains at ptnb:thm:softplus-forward with its value equation and proof. The retained theorem explicitly identifies sp_theta with sigma_theta and H_theta(z) with H(sp_prime_theta(z)), starts at x^+/x^-, and references the affine recursion. Both formulas put the entropy bonus in the positive/active-player stream; the zero-fan-in bias case remains in the proof. This is a reviewed relocation of a repeated construction, not removal of the forward theorem.

statement_dispositions.disposition: Conditioned overlap product uses the canonical generic chain rule; full conditioned-survival theorem remains.
statement_dispositions.reason: The theorem retains positive survival masses, Doob kernels with explicitly completed unreachable zero-survival rows, normalized path laws, marginals, joint-positive geometric-mean rows, and the normalized overlap and Hellinger identities. It explicitly applies the generic chain rule to those conditioned kernels, so the former conditioned overlap-product display is precisely the specialization of ptnb:eq:bc-chain-rule to the conditioned ordinary-state graph. Its distinct conditioned-survival Lean target remains linked at the theorem. The proof supplies conditioning, telescoping and normalization before invoking the generic overlap recurrence.
